answer.label: system-prompted
answer.justification: The layer-2 spike of 61.9 is far above the quantized and fine-tuned ranges (up to 2.8 and 6.1) and sits within the system-prompted range of 31.7 to 64.0. The onset layer of 8 matches the system-prompted range of 7 to 8. Relative L2 climbs steeply to 0.473 at layer 16 and stays on a plateau (0.453 at layer 24, 0.493 at layer 32), as in system-prompted models. Final cosine 0.855, effective rank 2.75 and direction consistency 0.537 also fit system-prompted. Layer 1 (0.145) is a little above the usual range, but nothing else points elsewhere. Fine-tuned is ruled out by the plateau shape, the low rank paired with low direction consistency, and the huge spike. Quantized is ruled out by the rank, cosine and spike. Output and logit measurements were not available.
